title: Divide by the factor outside the parentheses
text: 5 multiplies the whole group $$(y - 1)$$. Divide both sides by 5 first, or expand to $$5y - 5 = 20$$ and then undo the subtraction. Both paths work. A common mistake is to subtract 1 from 20 before dealing with the 5. What is $$20 \div 5$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$5(y - 1) = 20$$. Divide by 5: $$y - 1 = 4$$. Add 1: $$y = 5$$. Check: $$5(5 - 1) = 20$$. Expanding instead: $$5y - 5 = 20$$, $$5y = 25$$, $$y = 5$$. Common mistake: $$y - 1 = 20 - 5$$. General rule: a factor outside parentheses multiplies every term inside. Divide by that factor, or distribute, and then solve the resulting equation.
